Julie — thanks for the clear list. Short answers first, details and attachments below.

- Initial acknowledgement: within 24 hours of event detection (business hours) or within 4 hours for incidents causing service unavailability impacting customer SLAs.
- Interim update: we provide an interim update within 72 hours and then every 72 hours until root cause assessment is complete.
- Final report: typically within 14 calendar days for most incidents; extended injuries (major breach) are scoped with legal and customer teams — target 30 days.

Primary POC: Rishi Malhotra, Head of Security Response — rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, +1 650 555 2102 (24/7 pager).
Secondary POC: Vivek Kulkarni, Director, Production Ops — vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, +1 650 555 2110.

Attachments included: SIG_IR_Evidence_Index.csv, redwood_ir_runbook_v1.3.pdf, redwood_notify_sample-notice.txt

Julie / GreenBank Sec team — answering the three points inline and attaching the requested redacted tabletop report and audit-index pointers.

1) Legal involvement: Yes. Decision matrix is in redwood_ir_runbook_v1.3.pdf (Section 4.2: "Notification Approval Flow"). Quick summary: any incident meeting the following triggers requires Legal + CISO sign-off prior to customer notification: confirmed sensitive data exfiltration, regulatory impact (PII/PHI), cross-border data movement, or when contractually required to coordinate messaging. For lower-severity incidents (service degradation without data exposure), Ops may send initial acknowledgement within the standard windows and loop Legal within 24 hours.

2) Audit logs: Notification send events (both automated system notices and manual sends) are written to an append-only audit store with SHA-256 checksums and retained for 7 years to satisfy e-discovery and enterprise audit requests. Index pointers for the audit storage are in the attached SIG_IR_Evidence_Index.csv with sample identifiers. Storage is encrypted at rest using customer-segregated KMS keys for Private deployments and our managed KMS for Hosted.

3) Tabletop exercise: last full-tabletop (multi-team) exercise date: 2026-06-17. A redacted executive summary and action tracker are attached (redwood_tabletop_20260617_redacted.pdf). We also run smaller runbook drills quarterly; those logs are summarized in the evidence index.

Additional notes:
- Escalation roster (on-call & legal): see redwood_escalation-roster.csv — includes 24/7 pager numbers and escalation tiers.
- Sample notice: redwood_notify_sample-notice.txt shows the minimum fields we send and typical cadence notes.

If GreenBank would like a live walkthrough of the runbook and audit linkage (we can show the audit event ids and timeline mapping), Marissa from Compliance can run that. Suggested slots: Fri 2026-12-04 09:00-11:00 PT or Mon 2026-12-07 13:00-15:00 PT.
